source.author: ov
source.text: Iamque labant cunei, spoliataque tegmine cerae rima patet praebetque viam letalibus undis.
source.text_original: Iamque labant cunei, spoliataque tegmine cerae / rima patet praebetque viam letalibus undis.
source.text_english: And now the wedges are giving way, and the seam, stripped of its wax covering, opens and provides a path for the deadly waters.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: constitit ut longo moles non pervia ponto puppis, et ut tenues subiere latentia cerae lumina, picturae varios superaddit honores.
reuse.text_original: constitit ut longo moles non pervia ponto / puppis, et ut tenues subiere latentia cerae / lumina, picturae varios superaddit honores.
reuse.text_english: It was established that the bulk of the ship, impassable by the long sea, stood firm, and that the hidden lights were taken up beneath the thin wax; he adds to the painting various honors.
